profile.name: Maina Eric Kariuki
profile.title: ICT Professional & Web Developer
profile.summary: Motivated ICT professional with hands-on experience in web development, IT support, and digital design. Skilled in transforming technical ideas into practical solutions, managing digital platforms, and delivering meaningful results. Experienced in managing projects, coordinating technical workflows, and deploying live solutions. Adaptable, self-driven, and eager to contribute across diverse areas of computing and ICT, with strong problem-solving, communication, and teamwork skills.

projects.title: AquaFlow — Gamified Hydration Tracker
projects.problem: Busy professionals often neglect hydration and need an engaging system to track their daily water intake.
projects.solution: Developed a gamified hydration tracker boasting fluid animations, dynamic streaks, and leveling features independent of a backend.
projects.challenges: Engineering robust local-storage state management and orchestrating performant React micro-animations for UX delight.
projects.impact: Deployed a highly responsive, fast web app delivering an engaging UX that fosters healthy daily hydration habits.

projects.title: Business Website/Portfolio
projects.problem: A client needed an authoritative, lightning-fast digital storefront to capture and convert local leads.
projects.solution: Architected a high-converting, responsive landing site optimized for SEO, speed, and cross-device accessibility.
projects.challenges: Optimizing image assets, fine-tuning CSS architectures, and implementing secure direct contact interactions.
projects.impact: Successfully established the business's core online presence, significantly elevating prospect engagement and brand trust.

projects.title: Lipana STK Push Payment System
projects.problem: Merchants required an automated, hands-free integration with Kenya's M-Pesa mobile money system for online sales.
projects.solution: Engineered a Python/Flask microservice communicating securely with Daraja APIs, paired with a React frontend.
projects.challenges: Securing OAuth token lifecycles, processing asynchronous webhooks safely, and polling real-time system statuses.
projects.impact: Launched a robust, production-ready payment pipeline supporting end-to-end automated mobile transactions.

projects.title: Personal Portfolio Platform
projects.problem: Required a dynamic platform to consolidate technical capabilities, achievements, and real-world projects into a single hub.
projects.solution: Designed and deployed an interactive digital CV. Integrated automated dark mode, deep-scroll navigation, and modern glassmorphism.
projects.challenges: Managing complex state for global themes, orchestrating fluid typography typing effects, and structuring scalable code.
projects.impact: Acts as the primary professional demonstrator of capabilities, actively attracting employers and high-quality leads.

projects.title: Identity Rebrand Project
projects.problem: Small local businesses lacked professional, modern digital branding to compete effectively in online spaces.
projects.solution: Produced comprehensive digital branding materials including logos, colour harmony systems, and brand guidelines for clients.
projects.challenges: Synthesizing varied client needs into distinctive, memorable visual identities across multiple digital platforms.
projects.impact: Sharpened online presence and elevated professional perception for multiple SMBs in the regional community.

projects.title: Burp Suite Vulnerability Assessment
projects.problem: Web applications were intrinsically vulnerable to common, devastating security threats like XSS and SQL injection.
projects.solution: Conducted exhaustive security audits using advanced proxy tools to identify, document, and triage vulnerabilities securely.
projects.challenges: Executing deep penetration tests without permanently disrupting live system operations or violating compliance.
projects.impact: Uncovered critical cross-site scripting and injection flaws, supplying actionable fixes that hardened the systems.
